Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge
 Order

The grievance of the petitioner is that his land measuring 01 kanal 10 marlas in khasra No. 748 & 749 situated at village Khari District Ramban has been taken over by the respondent Nos.
6 to 9 way back in the year, 2011, whereafter, a hut was constructed by respondent Nos. 6 to 8 but till date, no compensation has paid to the petitioner.

been contended that on an earlier occasion, the respondents had initiated acquisition proceedings under the J&K Land Revenue Act but they could not complete the said proceedings within the stipulated time, as a result of which, the proceedings lapsed, whereafter, communications were exchanged by the respondents inter-se for initiation of fresh acquisition proceedings under the Act of 2013 but till date, nothing concrete has been done by the respondents.
Issue notice.
Ms. Aparna Gupta, Advocate appearing vice Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 to 5.
She seeks and is granted time to file objections.
Notice shall go to the other respondents subject to the petitioner's taking necessary steps within a week's time.
